sources.role: user-data paths, controller profile XML and Wii U storage

paths.path: ~/.config/Cemu/settings.xml (portable mode uses settings.xml beside cemu); controllerProfiles/ is beside the settings file or in the portable root.
controllerProfiles/controller0.xml through controller3.xml under the Cemu user-data root; the XML is written by Input settings and uses Cemu's controller API/device/button/axis elements.
paths.naming: Profile filenames are controller0.xml, controller1.xml, controller2.xml, controller3.xml or user-chosen XML; preserve source-generated XML because no stable text shorthand is documented.

paths.path: mlc01/usr/save/<title-id>/<persistent-id>/ (the Wii U virtual MLC); Cemu keeps title saves in the emulated filesystem, not beside the ROM.
paths.naming: Wii U title IDs are 16-hex directories; game-defined files live below the title/persistent-id directory.
evidence: docs:wiki.cemu.info Cemu MLC and save location

paths.path: Cemu desktop has no documented general-purpose save-state file/slot facility; suspend/resume or in-game saves are not emulator states.
paths.naming: Not applicable: no official Cemu state extension or slot directory.

paths.path: No BIOS image is required; Wii U system software is represented by the user-provided MLC (mlc01/sys and mlc01/usr), with system titles installed into the emulated filesystem.
paths.naming: No standalone BIOS filename/checksum. Cemu does not publish a canonical checksum for a complete MLC dump.

paths.path: keys.txt in the Cemu installation/portable root (or the configured Cemu data root) contains Wii U title keys; Cemu also uses common/system keys when required.
paths.naming: Exact file name is keys.txt; entries are title ID followed by a hexadecimal key (one mapping per line). The source does not publish canonical hashes for user key files.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/info.cemu.Cemu/config/Cemu/settings.xml with controllerProfiles/ in the same writable app root; portable configuration can remain beside the executable if explicitly selected.
The writable Cemu app data controllerProfiles/controller0.xml..controller3.xml files use the same source-defined XML schema.
paths.naming: controller<n>.xml or user-named XML profile; GUI-generated Cemu controller XML.

paths.path: Configured MLC writable data, typically ~/.var/app/info.cemu.Cemu/data/Cemu/mlc01/usr/save/<title-id>/<persistent-id>/.
paths.naming: 16-hex Wii U title-ID and persistent-ID directory layout.

paths.path: No documented Cemu save-state facility.
paths.naming: Not applicable.

paths.path: No standalone BIOS; the Flatpak uses the user-provided MLC system titles under mlc01/sys and mlc01/usr.
paths.naming: No universal BIOS filename/checksum.

paths.path: keys.txt in the configured/portable Cemu root or writable Flatpak data root.
paths.naming: keys.txt with title-ID=hex-key mappings; no canonical checksum for user keys.

paths.path: settings.xml and controllerProfiles/ beside Cemu.exe in the normal portable distribution; installed builds may use the Cemu user-data directory. Cemu's Windows portable layout is the deterministic documented baseline.
controllerProfiles\controller0.xml through controller3.xml beside Cemu.exe, written by Input settings; XML contains Cemu device/button/axis mappings.
paths.naming: controller<n>.xml or user-named XML profile; no alternate shorthand.

paths.path: mlc01\usr\save\<title-id>\<persistent-id>\ in the Cemu portable root.
paths.naming: 16-hex Wii U title-ID/persistent-ID directories with game-defined files below.

paths.path: No documented general Cemu save-state feature.
paths.naming: Not applicable.

paths.path: No standalone BIOS image; the portable MLC contains the Wii U system titles needed by the emulated environment.
paths.naming: No universal BIOS filename/checksum.

paths.path: keys.txt beside Cemu.exe in portable mode (or configured Cemu data root).
paths.naming: keys.txt title-ID/hex-key mappings; no canonical checksum published.

paths.path: Cemu settings.xml and controllerProfiles/ in the macOS Cemu application-support/user-data directory; portable builds use files beside Cemu.
controllerProfiles/controller0.xml..controller3.xml in the Cemu user-data root, using Cemu's generated XML controller schema.
paths.naming: controller<n>.xml or user-named profile XML.

paths.path: mlc01/usr/save/<title-id>/<persistent-id>/ below the configured Cemu MLC root.
paths.naming: 16-hex Wii U title-ID/persistent-ID directories.

paths.path: No documented Cemu save-state facility.
paths.naming: Not applicable.

paths.path: No standalone BIOS; Cemu expects Wii U system software in the configured MLC.
paths.naming: No universal BIOS filename/checksum.

paths.path: keys.txt in the configured Cemu data/portable root.
paths.naming: keys.txt title-ID/hex-key lines; no canonical checksum published.
